about: Human labels, written after reading each chain against the PRE-REGISTERED gold (strict). correct = contains the whole gold chain, every edge a real call, nothing off-flow. incomplete = true prefix, stops before the gold's last step. wrong = does not answer the goal. no-chain = the AST returns nothing.

notes.P6: RegisterUserController.handle -> RegisterUser.registerUserOnMailingList -> RegisterUserOnMailingList.registerUserOnMailingList: true prefix; the gold ends one step later, at UserRepository.add. A lenient reading would call it correct; the strict (pre-registered) reading calls it incomplete.
